lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\CollabCraft\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

places: lib/Service/TokenService.php:59 OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ: deprecated since Nextcloud 13; Use \OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ instead
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 30 to 31. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Service/TokenService.php:59 OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ: deprecated since Nextcloud 13; Use \OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ instead

The app reads and writes its app config in 4 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
Nothing in the app calls 1 OCS route. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
The app has 1 OCS route and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
